positions.description:
Yuri is a space biotech company that harnesses the uniqueness of space to develop bioproducts in oncology, synbio and tissue engineering. 

Built the company as Co-founder & Co-CEO from scratch to 40+ people with offices in 3 countries:

🚀 achieved 4 successful rocket launches (with 5 more in pipeline)
🌍 served customers in 25 countries across 4 continents (incl. NASA, GSK, MIT)
🤝 secured eight figures in customer contract value
💰 raised $6M from top VCs in Silicon Valley, NYC, Europe
🏆 earned numerous awards, incl. Deutscher Gründerpreis, EY
🧑‍🚀 assembled an incredible team that built the
🧬 world's most capable space biotech stack (go ScienceTaxi!)

Supported in setting up the newly founded unit "Digital Solutions", which grew from 20 to 70 people within 2 years. My main outcomes:

- Developed low-cost IoT solution (as product owner and project manager) to connect our global fleet of engines from idea to global rollout of 5000 devices. The project won the prestigious Sir Henry Royce Award.

- Initiated one of the biggest internal digital projects called "component tagging" 

- Supported the agile transformation of Rolls-Royce through top management keynotes (Top 200, Top 70), the introduction of a regular inspiration event called "Breakout" and various Design Thinking workshops
